Belinda was very nervous.
The Metropolitan Ballet Company was selecting a dancer to play Cinderella,
and she was going to audition.

Cinderella
Audition Venue
summary_zh: 本页左侧为图书版权页，包含书名、作者、出版社、ISBN等信息；右侧为绘本正文，描绘了主角贝琳达紧张地前往大都会芭蕾舞团的灰姑娘试演会场。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
指挥大师笑容满面地说：“啊！贝琳达。我真高兴你来了！这是我们的新舞者——罗拉小姐。我要从你们两人之中选一位，演灰姑娘这个角色。”

罗拉露出甜美的笑容，对贝琳达说：“我真的很想演这个角色，我总是能得到我想要的。再说，我的脚很完美，小小的，最适合演灰姑娘了。”

贝琳达的脚也很完美，不过刚好是大大的。
page_text_en:
The conductor smiled broadly and said, "Ah! Belinda. I'm so glad you're here! This is our new dancer—Miss Lola. I need to choose one of you two to play the role of Cinderella."

Lola smiled sweetly at Belinda and said, "I really want to play this role. I always get what I want. Besides, my feet are perfect—small and just right for Cinderella."

Belinda's feet were also perfect, just a bit too big.
summary_zh: 指挥大师宣布将从贝琳达和新舞者罗拉之间选出一人饰演灰姑娘，罗拉自信地表示自己脚小完美适合角色，而贝琳达的脚虽然完美但偏大。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
“来，开始吧！”指挥大师宣布。音乐响起。
罗拉跳得很高，
但不如贝琳达跳得那么高。
罗拉转得很快，
但不如贝琳达转得那么快。
page_text_en:
"Come on, let's begin!" announced the maestro. The music began.
Lola jumped very high,
but not as high as Belinda.
Lola spun very fast,
but not as fast as Belinda.
summary_zh: 在灰姑娘试演中，指挥大师宣布开始，音乐响起，罗拉和贝琳达分别展示跳跃和旋转技巧，贝琳达在两项中都表现得更出色。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗拉很优雅，但不如贝琳达那么优雅，
好像轻盈的雪花随风飞扬。
“谢谢你们！”指挥大师说，“你们都跳得很棒。贝琳达，恭喜你，你来演灰姑娘。罗拉小姐，请你跟其他的女舞者一起跳舞会那一幕。”
罗拉嘀咕着：
“不公平！”
page_text_en:
Lola was graceful, but not as graceful as Belinda,
like light snowflakes dancing in the wind.
"Thank you all!" said the maestro. "You both danced wonderfully. Belinda, congratulations, you will play Cinderella. Miss Lola, please dance the ball scene with the other female dancers."
Lola muttered:
"Unfair!"
summary_zh: 指挥大师宣布贝琳达获得灰姑娘角色，罗拉对此表示不满，认为不公平。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
大家排练了好几个星期。舞者们都不喜欢和罗拉一起练习。当指挥大师不注意的时候，她会推倒正在练习屈膝动作的人，还会辱骂正在练习踮脚上升的人。

终于到了演出那一晚。所有舞者忙成一团，穿上表演服装，系紧舞鞋，做热身动作。

罗拉对贝琳达说：“你能帮帮我……嗯……拿我的发带吗？在这里面，在很高的架子上。”
贝琳达跟着罗拉走进一间小储藏室。她转身要帮罗拉拿发带时，突然听到门被关上、锁起来了。
page_text_en:
The dancers had been rehearsing for several weeks. The other dancers didn't like practicing with Lola. When the conductor wasn't paying attention, she would push over dancers practicing knee bends and insult those practicing rising onto their toes.

Finally, the night of the performance arrived. All the dancers were busy, putting on their costumes, tying their ballet shoes, and warming up.

Lola said to Belinda, "Could you help me... uh... get my hair ribbon? It's in here, on a very high shelf."
Belinda followed Lola into a small storage room. As she turned to get the ribbon for Lola, she suddenly heard the door close and lock.
summary_zh: 本页描述了排练期间舞者们对罗拉的反感，以及演出当晚罗拉诱骗贝琳达进入储藏室并将其锁住的情节。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗拉把贝琳达锁在
储藏室里了！

“放我出去！”贝琳达大喊。
她还要跳舞啊！可是，每个人都
急急忙忙赶着上台，没人听到她的
喊声。
page_text_en:
Lola locked Belinda in
the storage room!

"Let me out!" Belinda shouted.
She still had to dance! But everyone was
hurrying to the stage, and no one heard her
cries.
summary_zh: 罗拉将贝琳达锁在储藏室，贝琳达大声呼救，但因众人忙于上台而无人听见。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗拉偷了贝琳达的玻璃鞋。这双鞋并不是玻璃做的，但非常光亮美丽。罗拉跑去找指挥大师。“贝琳达生病了，她请我代替她。”罗拉撒了谎。

“噢，天啊，那可怜的孩子！可是你怎么能代替她呢？舞会那一幕，你得穿上玻璃鞋，这鞋对你来说太大了。”指挥大师说。

罗拉说：“我有办法。”
page_text_en:
Lola stole Belinda's glass slippers. These shoes weren't made of glass, but they were very shiny and beautiful. Lola ran to find the conductor. "Belinda is sick, she asked me to take her place," Lola lied.

"Oh, my goodness, what a poor child! But how can you replace her? For the ball scene, you'll have to wear the glass slippers, and they're far too big for you," the conductor said.

Lola said, "I have a plan."
summary_zh: 罗拉偷走贝琳达的玻璃鞋，并谎称贝琳达生病，请求代替她演出。指挥大师担心鞋子对她太大，罗拉则表示自己有办法解决。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
她在玻璃鞋里塞了很多填充材料，把鞋和舞会时穿的舞衣一起藏好。她在身上系了一块破布，让自己看起来像灰姑娘。
然后，她急忙跑上舞台，正好赶上开幕。
罗拉开始跳舞。她的舞步都很正确，不过，指挥大师真希望她能跳得高一点，像贝琳达一样；也希望她能滑行得优雅一点，像贝琳达一样。
page_text_en:
She stuffed a lot of padding into the glass slipper, hid the shoe and the dress she would wear at the ball together. She tied a piece of rag around her body to make herself look like Cinderella.
Then, she hurried onto the stage, just in time for the curtain to rise.
Lola began to dance. Her steps were all correct, but the conductor truly wished she could jump higher, like Belinda; and also hoped she could glide more gracefully, like Belinda.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了罗拉为偷穿玻璃鞋并冒充灰姑娘所做的伪装，以及她在舞台上跳舞时，指挥大师对其表现的评价，认为她虽舞步正确，但不如贝琳达跳得高或滑行得优雅。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
“放我出去！”储藏室里的贝琳达拼命大叫。

就在这时，演神仙教母的舞者刚好经过，她听到贝琳达的叫声。她打开门，说：“你怎么在这里？舞会就要开始了。”她帮贝琳达换上舞衣。

“谢谢你！”贝琳达说，“可是，我的玻璃鞋到哪儿去了？”

“我不知道。”演神仙教母的舞者说，“就穿你脚上这双吧。快点儿，快来不及了！”
page_text_en:
"Let me out!" Belinda screamed desperately from inside the storage room.

Just then, the dancer playing the Fairy Godmother passed by and heard Belinda's cries. She opened the door and said, "What are you doing here? The ball is about to start." She helped Belinda put on her dance costume.

"Thank you!" Belinda said. "But where are my glass slippers?"

"I don't know," the dancer playing the Fairy Godmother replied. "Just wear the pair on your feet. Hurry up, we don't have time!"
summary_zh: 贝琳达被罗拉锁在储藏室中，大声呼救却无人回应。演出开始前，演神仙教母的舞者发现她并帮她换上舞衣，但贝琳达的玻璃鞋已不见，对方让她穿脚上的鞋赶去演出。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
舞会正要开始，贝琳达踏上舞台。每位女舞者轮流跟王子跳舞。轮到贝琳达时，王子挽着贝琳达，他们跳了一段美妙的双人舞。观众们看得惊叹连连。

“我才是灰姑娘。”罗拉一边说，一边挤上前要跟王子跳舞。她穿着贝琳达的玻璃鞋。

王子皱起眉头。
page_text_en:
The ball was about to begin, and Belinda stepped onto the stage. Each ballerina took turns dancing with the prince. When it was Belinda’s turn, the prince took her hand, and they danced a beautiful duet. The audience watched in awe.

“I’m Cinderella,” Lola said, pushing forward to dance with the prince. She was wearing Belinda’s glass slipper.

The prince frowned.
summary_zh: 舞会开始时，贝琳达与王子跳了精彩的双人舞，赢得观众赞叹。随后罗拉冒充灰姑娘，穿着贝琳达的玻璃鞋挤上前与王子跳舞，王子对此感到困惑和不满。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗拉跳跃、旋转，玻璃鞋却变得有点儿奇怪。
它们摇摇晃晃，弯曲变形了！鞋子里的填充材料
纷纷掉出来，她的脚好像突然缩小了。钟响了
十二下。
罗拉迈着她那双小小的脚逃下舞台，
留下一双大玻璃鞋。
page_text_en:
Lola jumped and twirled, but the glass slippers became a bit strange.
They wobbled and bent! The stuffing inside the shoes
fell out, and her feet seemed to suddenly shrink. The clock struck
twelve.
Lola scurried off the stage with her tiny feet,
leaving behind a pair of big glass slippers.
summary_zh: 罗拉穿着贝琳达的玻璃鞋在舞台上跳舞，鞋子因不合脚而变形破损，她仓皇逃下舞台，留下了一双大玻璃鞋。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
接下来的故事情节是，每位舞者都要试穿玻璃鞋。一旦王子找到适合这双鞋的脚，他就找到了真正爱的人——灰姑娘。舞者们一个接着一个试穿鞋子，可是没有人的脚适合这双鞋。

正要轮到贝琳达时，罗拉跑上来推开她。罗拉把脚伸进鞋子里，可是鞋子里的填充材料全没了，现在这双鞋对她来说当然太大了。罗拉生气地对王子说：“你假装大小刚刚好就是了！”

贝琳达受够了。她大步向前，优雅地向王子屈膝、鞠躬。王子很高兴地对她微笑，单脚下跪为她试穿鞋子。

贝琳达穿上去正好合脚。
page_text_en:
The next part of the story is that each dancer must try on the glass slipper. Once the prince finds the foot that fits the shoe, he has found his true love—the Cinderella. The dancers try on the shoe one by one, but no one's foot fits.

Just as it's Bella's turn, Lola rushes up and pushes her aside. Lola sticks her foot into the shoe, but the padding inside is gone, so the shoe is obviously too big for her. Lola angrily tells the prince, "Just pretend it fits perfectly!"

Bella has had enough. She steps forward gracefully, curtsies to the prince. The prince smiles happily at her and kneels on one knee to try the shoe on her.

The shoe fits Bella perfectly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了舞者们依次试穿玻璃鞋的场景，罗拉强行挤占机会但鞋子不合脚，而贝琳达最终试穿时鞋子完美合脚，王子为她试鞋并露出满意神情。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗拉气极了。她踩着脚对贝琳达说：“王子是我的！我要他！我总是能得到我想要的！”
“这次不行。”贝琳达说。
罗拉想用脚后跟踩贝琳达，
可是贝琳达旋转得很快，
让她无法靠近。
罗拉在后面追着贝琳达跳，可是贝琳达用完美的抬腿动作保护自己，
还做出了精彩、
漂亮的空中旋转。
page_text_en:
Lola was furious. She stomped her foot and said to Belinda, "The prince is mine! I want him! I always get what I want!"
"Not this time," Belinda said.
Lola tried to stomp on Belinda's heel,
but Belinda spun so fast,
she couldn't get close.
Lola chased after Belinda, but Belinda used perfect leg lifts to protect herself,
and also performed wonderful, beautiful leaps in the air.
summary_zh: 罗拉因嫉妒贝琳达与王子共舞而愤怒，试图用脚踩她，但贝琳达凭借灵活的舞步和高超的技巧成功躲避并保护自己。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
贝琳达赢得全场观众的喝彩，她跳得好高好高，像天上的彩虹。
罗拉趴倒在地上。她知道她输了。
在空中飞跃的贝琳达被王子稳稳地托住。
这出芭蕾舞剧演出非常成功。每个人都说，这是他们看过最棒的演出之一。很不一样！充满丰富的动作和表情！
page_text_en:
Belinda won the applause of the entire audience. She jumped so high, like a rainbow in the sky.
Lola lay on the ground. She knew she had lost.
Belinda, soaring through the air, was securely held by the prince.
This ballet performance was a great success. Everyone said it was one of the best shows they had ever seen. So different! Full of rich movements and expressions!
summary_zh: 贝琳达在舞台上精彩表演，赢得观众喝彩，而罗拉因失败趴倒在地。王子稳稳托住空中飞跃的贝琳达，演出获得巨大成功，观众称赞其充满丰富的动作和表情。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh: 指挥大师请所有舞者去享用蛋糕和热巧克力。每个人都很开心，除了罗拉。她决定不再跳舞了。
page_text_en: The conductor invited all the dancers to enjoy cake and hot chocolate. Everyone was happy, except for Lola. She decided she would no longer dance.
summary_zh: 舞会结束后，指挥大师请大家享用蛋糕和热巧克力，所有舞者都很开心，只有罗拉不高兴，她决定不再跳舞了。

title_en: Big Feet and the Glass Slipper
source_file: 大脚丫和玻璃鞋(4-7 岁)- .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗拉放弃芭蕾舞，去打曲棍球。

她的外号是“小脚丫”，因为她的脚真的很小。她在比赛中有很多次的激烈对抗，不过也赢了好几场比赛。
page_text_en:
Lola gave up ballet and went to play hockey.

Her nickname is 'Little Feet,' because her feet are really small. She had many intense confrontations in the games, but also won several matches.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了罗拉放弃芭蕾舞，转而打曲棍球，并因其小脚获得“小脚丫”的外号，她在比赛中表现出色，赢得多场比赛。
